reason: At 23 euros a litre I pay two to three times what Monin costs me, and my customers at a snack bar won't pay more for a cocktail because the syrup is fermented. I'd ask for the free sample out of curiosity, but I won't put it on my order.
objection: It raises my cost per cocktail without letting me raise the menu price. A 4-star hotel can absorb that, my bar can't.
would_change_my_mind: A price close to 12-14 euros a litre, or proof from a tasting that a signature drink with it sells at a higher price and my regulars actually order it.
